newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-Ireland league division one fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Ireland league division one fixtures.

text.p: Saturday's All-Ireland league division one fixtures are as follows. All games start at 1430 GMT.
Cork Constitution versus Old Wesley at Temple Hill.
Shannon versus Old Belvedere at Thomond Park.
Old Crescent versus Terenure College at Anglesea Road.
St.Mary's College versus Garryowen at Templeville Road.
Lansdowne versus Ballymena at Lansdowne Road.
Instonians versus Blackrock College at Shane Park.
Dungannon versus Young Munster at Stevenson Park.
